item.title: Comprehensive Solutions in Hoisting Equipment and Industrial Lifting
item.description:
Comprehensive Solutions in Hoisting Equipment and Industrial Lifting
#

Cheng Day International Group is recognized for its expertise in hoisting equipment manufacturing, serving a global clientele with a diverse portfolio of lifting solutions. Our operations are structured into four primary business departments: crane & hoist, elevator, parking system, and heavy duty. We are dedicated to every stage of the product lifecycle, from marketing and product design to manufacturing, testing, installation, and after-sales service.

item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for Heavy Lifting and Material Handling
item.description:
Comprehensive Solutions for Heavy Lifting and Material Handling
#

Cheng Day (Black Bear / U-Mega) stands as an internationally certified supplier and manufacturer of heavy lifting equipment, material handling systems, elevator, and parking solutions. With a strong foundation in research and development at our Taiwan headquarters, we design and produce a full spectrum of lifting equipment and related components, adhering to national and international standards such as CMAA, HMI, JIS, and FEM.
